mechanism_narrative: The current level of the federal funds rate (4.99%) is historically associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, and this relationship holds regardless of the specific value of the federal funds rate.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is at any level, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When labor market growth (PAYEMS) exceeds 135000 thousand persons and housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1900 thousand units, it indicates strong consumer demand and labor market conditions that support positive equity returns, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong labor and housing market conditions
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS > 135000 AND HOUST > 1900, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In regimes where consumer spending (RSAFS) exceeds 360000 million dollars and housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1900 thousand units, strong consumer demand supports positive equity returns, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS > 360000 AND HOUST > 1900, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 110 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 5.0%, it indicates a strong economy with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong economy with accommodative monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO > 110 AND FEDFUNDS < 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
